name: Artemis
description: Apache ActiveMQ Artemis over its Jolokia management API (the web console, port 8161). #target is the broker URL; #action is a command, its /queue or /address and clauses: QUEUES, ADDRESSES and CONSUMERS list (WHERE messages > 0, LIMIT n), BROWSE shows messages without consuming them, RECEIVE removes and returns them (WHERE takes a JMS selector), SEND puts a message on a queue and PUBLISH on an address (SET property = 'value'), PURGE deletes messages, MOVE ... TO /queue moves them, RETRY sends dead letters back, PAUSE and RESUME stop and restart delivery, JOLOKIA sends #payload to Jolokia as is. #headers are HTTP headers.
